description: Issue a complete agent passport with keys, signed passport, attestation summary, and optional values floor in a single call. The server silently captures Tier 0 observed signals and computes a passport grade (0-3). Use this to onboard any agent — no npm install required.

attest_to_floor.description: If true, attests to the default values floor (F-001 through F-008)

name: issue_passport
